summary_en: MIRAIT ONE Corporation authorized acquisition of up to 800,000 shares (0.9% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 2 billion yen through on-market purchases on Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and enable flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, the Board of Directors of MIRAIT ONE Corporation resolved to acquire treasury stock pursuant to Article 165, Paragraph 3 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 800,000 shares of common stock, representing 0.9% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum expenditure of 2 billion yen.

The acquisition will be conducted through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027. The per-share price ceiling is calculated at 2,500 yen based on the authorized expenditure limit and share quantity. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 3,796,876 treasury shares against 87,528,453 outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

The company stated that the purpose of this acquisition is to enhance shareholder returns and enable flexible and responsive capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The company noted that this treasury stock acquisition is unrelated to a separate simultaneous disclosure concerning additional contribution to a share-based compensation trust (BBT).
